lesson: Today we work on one technique, giving a feeling to the reader through a single plane object instead of naming the feeling. The poem does this with two things you can point to. First, just enough to see the water glass, the boots. Second, the boots come back to your mind as the thing you would pull on to start the day. The poem never says you feel the pull to get up and work. It shows you the boots and lets that stand for it. Here's why this works. A water glass and a pair of boots are ordinary. You have seen both. When the poem names them, you picture your own, and the readiness to start comes with them. Try this. Pick one object a person would touch first thing, and end near it instead of stating how they feel. The second time through listen for how the boots prepare you for the last two words.
